Name: Add Street Lights
Author: chelin00
Description:
[size=5]What this mod does
[/size]
[size=4]Adds new streetlights and glow effects to the darker outskirts of Pelican Town.[/size]

[list]
[*]Marnie’s Ranch: a new streetlight has been placed near the entrance.
[*]Leah’s Cottage: a streetlight now lights the path.
[*]Elliott’s Cabin: the existing lamp has been enhanced with a subtle glow.
[/list]
Both the sprite objects (streetlights) and the lighting effects are included, so everything works together seamlessly.
[size=3]With this mod, the valley’s outskirts will finally feel safe and welcoming during your late-night walks![/size]

[line]
[size=5]Requirements[/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.3.x
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[/list][line]
[size=5]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Download the main file.

[*]Unzip the folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].

[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.
[/list][line]
[size=5]How it works (technical)[/size]

[list]
[*]The SMAPI component adds custom streetlight sprites into the game world.
[*]The Content Patcher pack edits map properties to include new or modified light sources.
[*]When combined, this creates both the visual lamp objects and their functional glow at night.
[/list][line]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[list]
[*]Works with Content Patcher packs that alter maps, as long as they don’t overwrite the same lamp tiles.
[*]Should not conflict with other Harmony mods, since no game methods are patched.
[*]Multiplayer not specifically tested; light effects should apply for all players but host behavior may vary.
[/list][line]
[size=5]Limitations / Non-goals[/size]

[list]
[*]Only adds the three specified lamps (Marnie’s, Leah’s, Elliott’s).
[*]Does not alter interior lighting or other areas of the valley.
[*]Not intended as a full lighting overhaul.
[/list][line]
[size=5]Troubleshooting[/size]

[list]
[*]Lamp not visible? Check that the mod folder is correctly placed inside [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*]No glow effect? Confirm that SMAPI shows the mod as loaded.
[*]Conflicts with other map mods may require manual adjustment.
[/list][line]
[size=5]Author’s Note & Credit[/size]

I have never used map editing tools, so I chose to implement this entirely with SMAPI code.
You may share this mod; please link back to this page. Reuse of assets/code is fine with credit.
[line]
